name: The Material Register
summary: A catalogue identity that gives samples a consistent record so texture, construction and provenance can be compared.

typography.usage: Titles and short section openings; source used style F25Break.
Reading text, supporting labels and detailed explanations; source used style F25Break.

recognitionRules: Use Arial for specimen names and monospaced identifiers for records.
Keep one specimen per repeated unit with stable label positions.
Separate observed material properties from intended uses.
Use white space and thin rules so the sample remains the dominant visual.

principles: Invite attention before offering interpretation; keep object facts and imaginative response distinct.
Use the identity’s sample as a rhythm and vocabulary reference, not as a factual project claim.
voice.sample: Name the sample. Note what it does. Keep the record with the material.
voice.sampleStatus: Original fictional brand copy authored for this guide, not a quotation or factual claim.
avoid: Avoid prescribing a viewer’s feelings or implying unverified provenance.
Avoid invented testimonials, performance claims and quotation attribution.
voice.secondaryExample: Look at the edge, then read the record.
voice.cadence: Short opening, concrete follow-through; vary sentence length for explanation.

logoDirection: Use THE MATERIAL REGISTER in Arial with a small specimen code in Courier. No abstract material swatch logo.
invariants: Use Arial for specimen names and monospaced identifiers for records.
Keep one specimen per repeated unit with stable label positions.
Separate observed material properties from intended uses.
adaptations: Digital entries can add images without changing the record order.
A physical label keeps ID, material and source together.
Keep the full name with any new symbol until the audience can recognize it independently.

fonts.sourceFontDependency: Arial is a separately licensed Microsoft/system font; not bundled.
Arial is a separately licensed Microsoft/system font; not bundled.

clearSpaceRule: Keep one half of the main wordmark cap height clear around the full silhouette, including its source-derived supporting device.

minimumSize.status: production minimum based on rendered 220/180px wordmark and 32/64px symbol inspection; verify again for unusual substrates
